newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui vice-president to join DuPont board.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui vice-president to join DuPont board.

text.p: DuPont Co has elected Goro Watanabe, executive vice-president of Japanese trading house Mitsui & Co Ltd, as a board member, the company's Japanese subsidiary DuPont KK said on Wedensday.

In a statement, DuPont chairman Edgar S. Woolard said: "Goro Watanabe will strengthen the global business perspective of our board. This is particularly important with the growth plans we have for the Asia-Pacific region."
Mitsui and DuPont KK set up an equally owned joint venture in 1993 to expand the marketing of DuPont products in Asia.
